cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: The speaker says, "we can send Vice President Kamala Harris to the White House." The speaker's shirt and the backdrop also appear to have her name.

cast.name: unnamed speaker
cast.evidence: A woman is shown speaking at a podium for the entire video.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the official @democrats account and is about their campaign efforts.

on_screen_text.text: 1.7M DOORS AND COUNTING! THIS IS YOUR SIGN TO SIGN UP FOR A SHIFT!

spoken_summary: Speaking at a rally in North Carolina, a woman touts the campaign's success, stating they have knocked on over 1.7 million doors since Kamala Harris entered the race. She calls on the audience to help with get-out-the-vote efforts like door-knocking and phone calls, urging them to channel their energy into voting to "send Vice President Kamala Harris to the White House." The crowd cheers enthusiastically in response.
audio_music: The audio consists of a woman's speech at a rally, with the prominent sound of a large, cheering crowd in the background, which gets louder at key moments. There is no music.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of the speaker at the podium. The main editing feature is the use of sequential, large text overlays that emphasize the words she is speaking.
central_claim: The Kamala Harris campaign has an impressive ground game in North Carolina, and a final volunteer push can secure victory.
intended_effect: To motivate supporters to volunteer for get-out-the-vote efforts and to foster a sense of momentum and imminent victory.
